The city was a bishopric and is mentioned in historical records as early as the 6th century.

Another theory suggests that the name Malvian may be derived from the name of St. Malvus, a bishop of Malevi who lived during the late 5th or early 6th century. According to legend, St. Malvus was a hermit who lived in the area and was known for his miraculous healings. The name Malvian may have been given in his honor.
